name: freshness-read-failure-display-claims-contention
body: The shared `Display` renders every `FreshnessReadFailure` as contention (`waited … of a … budget for the contention to clear`), including a presence-probe metadata error such as EACCES, which the plan-verify and project-start refusal branches then advise as another process's lock; upgrade when those refusal messages gain the absent-versus-read-failure distinction that `staleness_line` carries.
